command:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import merge_pair_v2 as merge
from src.tools.t01v2_look_unit_review_checkpoint import source_support
from src.tools.t01v2_posthoc_solvability import verified_passed_rows
name = "pilot_pairs_v2_look60_seq_01_j707558_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan203"
with source_support():
 data, source = merge.load_source(merge.ROOT / "results" / (name + ".json"))
cfg, metrics = data["config"], data["metrics"]
eligibility, journal_ref, _ = verified_passed_rows(data)
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in merge.reference_path(journal_ref, within=merge.ROOT / "data/world_pairs/v2").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
last = rows[-1]
if last["pair_id"] != "floorplan203_00027":
 raise ValueError("Unexpected terminal journal row")
attempt = merge.read_reference(last["raw_attempt"], within=cfg["raw_evidence_dir"])
if last["raw_attempt"]["sha256"] != "5a3def82f6460f9de080b092276239d01fef5680876a94026bccb1ae319dcedf" or any(attempt.get(key) != last.get(key) for key in ("pair_id","scene","status","discard_reasons")):
 raise ValueError("Terminal raw/journal reference differs")
pool_path = str(Path(cfg["raw_evidence_dir"]) / "marked_controller_001/construction/projection_pools_000990.json")
matches = [item for item in metrics["pool_catalogs"] if item["reference"]["file"] == pool_path]
if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0]["reference"]["sha256"] != "aa3d4cf76c35196c6969e28b3187bc5fd9715fd91fe1d05efdcadd622d62b4fb":
 raise ValueError("Missing or changed audited bilateral catalog")
catalog = matches[0]
pool = merge.read_reference(catalog["reference"], within=cfg["raw_evidence_dir"])
if pool["identity"] != catalog["identity"] or pool["view"] != catalog["view"] or pool["counts"] != catalog["counts"]:
 raise ValueError("Catalog summary differs from authenticated raw pool")
print("FLIP_EXISTING_FOLLOWUP_JSON: " + json.dumps({
 "bilateral_catalog": {"reference": catalog["reference"], "identity": pool["identity"], "view": pool["view"], "counts": pool["counts"]},
 "terminal_attempt": {"reference": last["raw_attempt"], **{key:attempt.get(key) for key in ("pair_id","mode","search_controller_id","projection_pool_reference","discard_reasons","generation_seconds","counts_as_pair_attempt")}, "role_domain": attempt["proposal"]["role_domain"]},
 "deadline_source": {"result_reference": {key:source[key] for key in ("file","sha256","metrics_sha256")}, "meta_reference":{"file":source["meta_file"],"sha256":source["meta_sha256"]}, "meta":{key:data["_meta"].get(key) for key in ("start","end","exit_code")}, "status":metrics.get("status"),"error":metrics.get("error"),"terminal_generator_status":metrics.get("terminal_generator_status"),"eligibility":eligibility},
 "scope":"Only authenticated existing fields; scheduler explanation is an inference, not a new measured count."
}, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False))
